name: When should I consider functional layout improvements for my home?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider functional layout improvements for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider functional layout improvements if your current space feels cramped, inefficient, or doesn't meet your lifestyle needs. This often happens after a change in family size, working from home, or simply desiring a more modern and open living environment. If you're frequently frustrated by the flow of your home or wish certain areas were more useful, it's a good time to explore layout changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider layout improvements when your space feels inefficient or no longer suits your lifestyle.
